headline: Morocco reach World Cup quarterfinals after 3-0 win over Canada
summary: Azzedine Ounahi's double secures a clinical victory in Houston, ending Canada's historic run as the first co-host to exit the tournament.
details: Morocco advanced to the World Cup quarterfinals on Saturday in Houston, defeating Canada 3-0. The victory makes them one of the last eight teams remaining in the tournament.

The match began with a high-tension first half, resulting in six yellow cards and very few shots on target. A brief shoving match between Morocco's Achraf Hakimi and Canada's Richie Laryea also led to bookings for both players.
The deadlock was broken in the 50th minute when midfielder Azzedine Ounahi scored the opener. He later added a second goal in the 82nd minute on a breakaway to seal the result.
Substitute Soufiane Rahimi added a third goal with the last kick of the match, completing the clinical performance by the 2022 semi-finalists.
Canada, playing the biggest game in their history, started strongly and forced a save from goalkeeper Yassine Bounou. However, they were unable to convert their early pressure into goals.
The match was played in front of a crowd of 68,777 fans at the Houston Stadium, where Morocco supporters outnumbered the home side's fans.
Morocco will now face either France or Paraguay in the quarterfinals. Canada becomes the first of the co-hosts to be eliminated from the competition.

The match was played in front of a crowd of 68,777 fans at the Houston Stadium, where Morocco supporters outnumbered the home side's fans.

headline: JU suspends 12 students over ragging allegations
summary: Students from the History department's 54th batch were accused of harassing first-year students under the pretext of teaching them 'manners'.
details: Jahangirnagar University has suspended 12 students from the History department following allegations of ragging first-year students from the same department.
The decision was announced in a notice signed by JU acting registrar Dr ABM Azizur Rahman on Saturday night.
The incident occurred between 11:00 PM on July 3 and 2:00 AM on July 4 at the Jahangirnagar University School and College playground.
According to the notice, students from the 54th batch (academic session 2024-25) summoned first-year students from the 55th batch (academic session 2025-26) to the playground.
The victims were reportedly verbally abused and forced to hold their ears as part of a perceived need to teach them 'manners'.
The university administration stated that the Jahangirnagar University Students' Discipline Ordinance, 2018 prohibits all forms of teasing, ragging, and abusive behavior on campus.
The suspended students include Nasim Uddin Majumder, Md Mahfuzur Rahman Onto, Abdullah Mahdi, Shubhashish Roy Pranto, and others.
The university took this action to maintain discipline and uphold the campus ordinance against harassment.
